title: blockr.dock 0.1.2
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-13 block-browser, link-menu, stack-menu sidebar UI components now bundled directly blockr.dock instead imported (non-CRAN) blockr.ui package, blockr.dock installs CRAN remote dependencies. Panel operations now first-class verbs views$mod update payload (add / rm / move / select), panels named new typed references blk() / ext() instead wire-id prefixes. Breaking: old set-replace membership form retired. views$mod grammar gains resize verb – resize = list(blk("", size = 0.3)) sets panel’s group size along splitview axis (ratio (0, 1)), delivered dockViewR’s set_size proxy. Like move / select client-owned geometry: pure delivery, captured grid mirror, board write (#320). saved dock layout now round-trips exactly export / import cycle – reloaded board re-exports tab groups, active tabs sizes. Previously transient frame client reports restore still settling captured stored geometry, flattening tab group separate leaves emptying view (#343). Breaking: extension’s id now owned container (mirroring blocks), serving single identity everywhere – wire panel id, DOM handle, module namespace ext() target. Breaking (extension authors): extension’s live result now reaches actions, callbacks peer extensions extensions bundle keyed extension id; new exported extension_ids() resolves class runtime id(s) container assigned. dock extension opens block’s panel views grammar (compose active + select) rather retired live dock handle; exported show_panel() removed. block status badge now one exported helper, block_status_badge(), shared blockr.dag dock card icon DAG node badge render identically; dock dot now also reflects render-phase errors. Renaming block longer crashes board block absent view – placed one view, parked offcanvas panel. board’s per-view layout splits two independent slots: server-authoritative dock_views structure collection (read board_views()) separate NULL-valid dock_grids geometry slot (board_grids()), grid validated subset view’s membership. Block eval status now first-class panel affordance: waiting unset block shows dedicated placeholder instead generic warning, colour-coded dot card header marks waiting, unset failed blocks glance. Per-block condition UI (warnings, messages, errors) updated surgically stable condition id, persistent warning longer flashes every re-evaluation. intrusive page-wide busy pulse replaced small, unobtrusive spinner navbar, just left board-options gear. always occupies slot dim, static ring , session real block evaluation, rises full contrast spins – scoped (pulse ) genuinely recomputing output visible view, startup block evaluation liven bare panel switch . always present never shifts neighbours never blinks ; configurable minimum-busy delay (blockr.spinner_delay_ms, default 200 ms; 0 disable) holds transition busy state sub-threshold flush longer flashes (#345, #355, #360). “Edit board” extension longer churns board re-emit – re-syncs staged working copy links stacks actually change, stops flickering manage-links cell inputs, overlays half-finished staged edits instead clobbering . Dock extensions now receive view_data, live -views layout reactive serialization also reads (NULL every view reported , req() ); active-view dock handle retired extension surface. Multi-view boards longer emit burst redundant board updates startup; fold mirrored every dockview focus tick back board_layouts removed, live layout read demand instead. dock longer loops tears panels slow client: view’s arrangement now client-owned flows dock -> board , removing reconcile push whose echo restore impoverished layout. Live panel rearrangements longer lost save – view_data(), live layout serialization reads, longer stays stuck NULL whole session. Adding block dock view finished initialising longer throws argument length zero. block, link stack action handlers now mount corresponding blockr.ui menu modules (card-list pickers search inline editing), replacing every per-field Shiny input; link menu adds bidirectional source / target picking stack menu inline colour picker. block browsers pre-rendered toggled rather rebuilt open, dock-side *_sidebar_body() bodies spec helpers removed. Layout deserialization now routes producing blockr.dock version (read constructor$version) rather sniffing payload shape, keeping shape discrimination fallback version-less payloads. dock “manager” object gone: apply_board_update.dock_board() pure reducer live view surgery runs one reconcile pass driven committed board. augment_board_update.dock_board() now idempotent, fixing view-add loop. Views now carry stable, immutable id decoupled editable display name (mirroring blocks): dock_layouts keyed id, name read written via view_name() / view_name<-(), views delta gains rename slot. new_dock_board(layouts = list(...)) list name view’s id, producers addressed views name (e.g. blockr.assistant) must switch ids. dock_layout now format() / print() methods render arrangement indented tree; panel ids print without wire prefixes unless bare = FALSE. views slot board_update payload structured delta (add / mod / rm / active) instead wholesale dock_layouts replacement, composing atomically blocks / links / stacks. UI-driven layout changes (panel close / add, drag-resize, view CRUD) route lifecycle debounced (250 ms), removing block drops panel surgically rather clearing active view. Requires blockr.core (>= 0.1.3).

title: blockr.dock 0.1.1
text: CRAN release: 2026-04-29 Added prepend block action. Define multi-view boards passing named list new_dock_board(layouts = ...): Mark arrangement initially active dock_layout(..., active = TRUE): none marked, first one used. board’s initialise_layout normalises slot dock_layout (storing arrangement ), stores result dock_layouts collection. Breaking changes layout API: Renamed new_dock_board()’s layout parameter layouts (corresponding board field), since boards now hold dock_layouts collection. Renamed board accessor dock_layout(brd) (setter dock_layout(brd) <-) active_layout(brd) / active_layout(brd) <-. Renamed board_views(brd) board_layouts(brd), corresponding setter dock_layouts(brd) <- value board_layouts(brd) <- value. dock_layout now per-view arrangement type. dock_layout(...) constructs one nested list block / extension IDs accepts orientation, sizes, active arguments. previously-exported “fully-resolved” dock_layout (grid + panels wire shape) gone — panel content derived board’s blocks extensions demand dockview boundary, per-view storage shrinks just arrangement panel definitions longer duplicate across views. Added panels(..., active = NULL) tabbed leaves explicit open tab, group(..., sizes = NULL) nested branches explicit ratios. dock_layout() also accepts sizes = root-level ratios orientation = top-level split direction. Removed dock_view(), dock_grid(), is_dock_grid(), as_dock_grid(). Use dock_layout(...) (new panels() / group()) per-view spec. Renamed default_layout() → kept name default_layout(). now returns dock_layout (arrangement ) — previously-exported default_grid() (panel-ID form) gone. Unexported high-level resolver create_dock_layout() (renamed internally resolve_dock_layout()). Unexported dock_layouts() constructor. user-facing input shape new_dock_board(layouts = ...) plain named list — dock_layouts type resolved collection board holds internally. is_dock_layouts(), as_dock_layouts(), validate_dock_layouts() remain exported. Unexported new_dock_layout(); use dock_layout() instead. Unexported view_ids() view_can_crud(). internal helpers exposed accident; renamed layout_ids() views_can_crud() respectively align operate . Wire format serialised dock_layout decoupled dockview’s internal tree. persisted shape flattened recursive spec: top object carries orientation, children, optional sizes, optional focus (panel current focus); child bare string (single-panel leaf), {panels, active?} object (tabbed leaf), {children, sizes?} object (nested branch). Sizes ratios (auto-normalised dockview’s pixel sizes); even splits omit sizes; default open tab omits active; focus first leaf omits focus. focus round-trips focused group (dockview’s activeGroup) naming stable panel rather regenerated group id. Legacy payloads (dockview-shape grid field) load via shape-discriminated reader. Producer-version routing tracked #153 (depends blockr.core forwarding ... blockr_deser.list). Layout conversion API split boundary. R object ↔︎ R list boundary uses coercion: as_dock_layout() coerces dock_layout (identity), board (active layout), spec list dock_layout; .list() dock_layout returns spec list. R object ↔︎ JSON string boundary uses explicit verbs: layout_to_json() / layout_from_json(). as_dock_layout(<list>) layout_from_json() take optional blocks / extensions resolve bare IDs validate. layout_panel_ids() / panel_obj_ids() inspect panel / object IDs layout references. dockview wire format converters part public API — dock_layout object, JSON, spec list ; as_dock_layout() rejects dockview grid-shaped list.
